reason: Complete the independent prospective registration review before market capture/fitting or quality observations. No residual-MLP recipe or implementation budget changes. Original registration and first amendment remain immutable evidence.

dataset.designRationale: Aligned three-asset minute observations, H128 histories, multiple temporal horizons, separately fitted chronological stages, common future observables and dependence-aware comparisons. This is a prospective design label, not measured difficulty or accuracy.
dataset.stagePolicy: All origins/targets retain the exact admitted source bytes and complete-envelope purges; model-derived arrays are not yet captured. Retain every excluded row and reason.

uncertainty.quantile: Inverse empirical CDF (nearest-rank type1): sorted bootstrap statistic at one-based ceil(B*p), clamped1..B. Lower p=alpha/2, upper p=1-alpha/2. B262144 supplies25.6 expected order-statistic observations per extreme tail. Require B*perTailAlpha>=20 and at least6 full chronological512-origin blocks; otherwise the affected scientific claim is inconclusive.
uncertainty.pairedPolicy: Use circular moving blocks of entire origin vectors. Retain all assets, horizons, arms and methods together in each draw; average per-origin losses over all3 declared seeds before paired resampling. Publish every per-seed result and excluded-origin count. Enumerate at most256 claim/observable/horizon contrasts in the prospective execution closure; unused family slots never loosen alpha.

targets.input: Each origin's original intact raw H128 window, semantic channel orderBTC/ETH/SOL and nine-feature registry order; observed finite source values only, no synthetic mask change. Adjacent positive observed closes produce log(close[j])-log(close[j-1]); never bridge a missing tick.
targets.pastVolatility: Across-channel mean of per-channel population std of adjacent log close returns; at least8 eligible returns in every channel; units logreturn
targets.pastTrend: Across-channel mean of per-channel mean adjacent log close returns; at least8 eligible returns in every channel; units logreturn/tick
targets.pastActivity: Across-channel mean of per-channel mean log1p(nonnegative observed base_volume); at least8 eligible volumes in every channel; units log1p(base_volume)
targets.pastRelation: Mean Pearson correlation over eligible channel pairs on each pair's common adjacent-return support; at least2 pairs each with at least8 returns and both population variances>=1e-12; units correlation
targets.unsupported: Keep per-target invalid masks; stored zero is not an observed label. Compare methods on the same eligible origin/target intersection.

retentionAndDiversity.probeFitting: Fit a new fixed probe on later January24-25 risk-head TRAIN origins after the representation/control cutoff. Predict January26-28 development-evaluation origins after the probe fit cutoff. Fit the same4-target probes independently for native-e, online-state and target-state features of each arm/seed. Reuse only the unchanged algorithm, never historical scores or fitted heads.
retentionAndDiversity.normalization: For each method, freeze equal-weight TRAIN feature means and population std with floor1e-8. For each target, freeze mean/population std on its common valid TRAIN rows with floor1e-8. Reject fewer than2 eligible fit rows. Report raw-unit MAE/RMSE/R2 plus normalized MSE using frozen TRAIN target scale; target TRAIN variance<=1e-12 makes relative/normalized claim unsupported and inconclusive.
retentionAndDiversity.heads: Exactly the source-pinned fixed_regression algorithm: ridge penalty1; independent tanh16 neural head with4 outputs,100 full-batch Adam0.01 updates, default beta0.9/0.999 eps1e-8 and no weight decay. Repetition stream labels2701/2802/2903 are mapped through pinned stream_seed(repetition,input_width36); no seed selection. Initialization and all mask/reduction semantics are fixed by the pinned source.
retentionAndDiversity.retentionRule: Per observable/head family, upper simultaneous95% bound on relative normalized MSE degradation versus the newly fitted same-recipe native-e probe is at most0.05; unsupported reference variance/coverage makes eligibility inconclusive
retentionAndDiversity.diversityPopulation: All distinct complete mature representation-TRAIN windows admitted at the representation cutoff, equal row weight1, evaluated separately for online and target states of every arm/seed after fitting. Never use evaluation or risk-TRAIN rows to fit/adapt the reference scale.
retentionAndDiversity.diversityArithmetic: Pinned diversity(): center the selected F64 saved state array and form sample covariance Xc^T*Xc/(N-1). Native std=sqrt(max(diag(cov),0)); reference ratio=nativeStd/frozenInitialTrainReference. Reference scales are initial-state TRAIN population std floored1e-8. Normalize cov by outer product of reference scales; clamp eigvalsh eigenvalues below0 to0, p=eig/sum(eig). Effective rank=exp(-sum_{p>0} p*log(p)); largest factor=max(p). Require N>=2 and positive eigenvalue sum>1e-12; otherwise unsupported/inconclusive. The rank bound is min(D,N-1).

stateOnlyEligibility: Eligibility to ENTER a separately scored risk comparison requires current correctness, chronology, coverage, registered retention and diversity safeguards. It does not require already supported risk utility. The predeclared state-only branch may remain eligible when latent point skill fails; actual common-observable utility is decided later and cannot be inferred from eligibility.
riskForecastIncrement: Compare forecast-augmented K4 e against the identical unaugmented K4 e, and forecast-augmented K4 online z against the identical unaugmented K4 online z, alongside every declared conventional/direct-embedding/capacity/placebo reference. An improvement only over another input history does not establish forecast increment. Require the same registered useful5% bound for the exact increment claim; affine-folding identity, normalization/bias accounting and regularization/parameterization limitations remain mandatory. A narrower state-only utility claim stays separately assessable.

capacityControl.forecastAssistedReferenceParameters: 17484 residual-MLP forecast parameters plus1518 for a252-input six-target affine readout =19002
capacityControl.budgetInterpretation: 30 additional parameters, about0.16% larger than the forecast-assisted reference, within a19200 cap. Disclose both totals; no exact parameter-equality claim. All upstream-control parameters and readout parameters count.
capacityControl.initialization: Local per-repetition Xavier-uniform gain1 for both weights, zero biases; fixed tanh activation
capacityControl.fitStage: Later risk-head TRAIN only, with complete mature common-observable targets; no representation/control refit

placebo: For each matched forecast arm, estimate per-coordinate forecast means/population std only from its legal issued later risk-TRAIN features (no future labels), floor std1e-8 and freeze. Generate label-independent standard-normal values by deterministic Box-Muller from SHA256(seed944501, immutable origin ID, coordinate, draw index), mapping unsigned64 bits to open(0,1) by (u+0.5)/2^64. Apply those frozen moments and retain matched dimensionality108. Same readout, common populations, stage cutoffs and comparison pins; never derive noise from outcomes.

conventional.trailingReference: Trailing128 adjacent close returns within the identical permitted131-close raw envelope. Compute population return dispersion and max(0,-minimum log close ratio to the start of that trailing128-return window)); report declared historical downside proxy, not an unbiased future estimator
conventional.ewma: Use all130 adjacent positive-close returns in the131-close history. alpha=2^(-1/32), weight of j-th previous return=(1-alpha)*alpha^j for j0..129, renormalized by finite sum of weights. Weighted mean=sum(w*r)/sumw and variance=sum(w*(r-mean)^2)/sumw; std in one-minute logreturn units. No hidden initial variance or carried pre-window state, no annualization. The finite normalized window is the complete initialization.
conventional.policy: Same legal source/support/missingness policy and no extra context. Record per-target matching and conventional recipe identities.

executionPolicy: Pin the original card and both amendments in the future execution closure. Registration does not close engineering, control/reporting implementation, capture or shared-study gates. This bounded source/synthetic task produces no market quality, state/point-skill/risk decision, or independent confirmation.
